newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Gaddafi supports U.N. intervention in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Gaddafi supports U.N. intervention in Zaire.

text.p: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi on Sunday said that the situation in the Great Lakes region of Central Africa required United Nations intervention, the Libyan official news agency JANA reported on Sunday.

"The dramatic and dangerous situation in the Great Lakes region really needs an intervention of the international community to put an end to this human drama," JANA, monitored in Tunis, quoted Gaddafi as saying.
"But this intervention must be by the United Nations alone," he added.

U.N. special envoy Raymond Chretien said on Sunday a multinational humanitarian force was still needed in troubled eastern Zaire despite the fact tens of thousands of Hutu refugees were returning to Rwanda.
